name: 한은정

appearance_en.face_shape: rounded oval face, soft cheekbones, slightly full jaw softened further by age — a face designed to be liked, maintained with effort
appearance_en.skin: fair Korean skin, foundation-covered but not hiding the deepening nasolabial folds or the slight puffiness under the eyes from chronic poor sleep; powder finish by morning, visible fatigue creeping through by afternoon
appearance_en.eyes: double eyelid, warm dark brown iris, outer corners lifted by years of habitual wide smiling — when the performance drops, the corners fall with accumulated exhaustion; mascara always present, occasionally flecked by midday; whites slightly reddened after crying alone
appearance_en.nose: medium, softly rounded tip, feminine and receding — the nose that disappears in a smile
appearance_en.mouth: fuller lips, always with lip colour applied, the corners trained upward in a reflexive social smile; at rest — when truly alone — the mouth goes flat and slightly downturned, a face she allows no one to see
appearance_en.eyebrows: arched and filled, slightly darker than her natural brow, drawn on with precision every morning; the left brow rises fractionally when she registers a slight before her face re-settles into warmth
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: smile lines at outer eye corners deepened beyond their age by decades of forced laughter; a faint jaw tension groove visible when she is not performing; a very small mole below the left outer eye corner
appearance_en.hair: shoulder-length dark brown hair, permed to soft waves, always salon-fresh in public — never a strand out of place; at home the waves deflate, the roots expose grey she has not yet acknowledged

body.proportions: fuller figure at hip and waist that middle age has softened further, always dressed in structured blouses and straight-cut trousers to minimize this; not overweight — the body of a woman who used to be slimmer and is managing the distance from that version of herself
body.posture: chin slightly lifted, shoulders deliberately squared back — a posture of social projection learned over decades; the moment she is alone it collapses forward and her head drops
body.body_prompt: 162cm fuller middle-aged Korean woman, chin slightly lifted shoulders squared back as conscious social posture, structured clothing hiding figure change, practiced composure that collapses in private

default.description: cream or blush structured blouse with clean neckline, dark straight-cut trousers or midi skirt, small gold stud earrings, slim gold watch — the daily costume of someone who cannot afford to look like she is struggling
default.wardrobe_prompt: cream or blush structured blouse, dark straight trousers or modest midi skirt, small gold stud earrings, thin gold watch, full day makeup

social.description: dusty rose cardigan or patterned silk blouse, dark tailored trousers, modest block heels — overdressed by exactly one level for every occasion, the gap between occasion and outfit a measure of how hard she is trying
social.wardrobe_prompt: dusty rose cardigan or patterned silk blouse, dark tailored trousers, modest block heels, one degree overdressed for occasion

home.description: plain beige or grey loose loungewear, hair gone flat with visible grey roots, no makeup — the version of herself she permits only in private
home.wardrobe_prompt: plain beige or grey loose comfortable loungewear, unstyled flat hair with grey roots showing, no makeup, bare face

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: resting social face is warmth performed at full volume — smile slightly too practiced, eyes slightly too bright, the whole face working harder than the situation demands; in unguarded moments the face underneath is simply tired
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: rounded oval-faced Korean woman early 50s, warm dark eyes with smile-lines from decades of forced laughing, arched filled brows, shoulder-length soft-permed dark brown hair professionally styled, 162cm fuller middle-aged figure with deliberately upright lifted-chin posture, fair foundation-covered skin over deepening fatigue, small mole below left outer eye corner, the face of a woman performing composure as survival

style_prompt: oil painting thick impasto brushstrokes, noir chiaroscuro, strictly four-color palette: deep black shadow beneath decades of social performance, warm amber of a smile trained over decades as primary light source, steel blue of the private face she shows only alone, painterly figurative realism, Korean drama cinematic composition, the gap between performed warmth and private collapse painted in oil weight
negative_prompt: photorealistic, anime, flat cartoon, CGI, 3d render, colors outside palette, green, yellow, purple, extra limbs, ugly, deformed, text, watermark, genuinely happy, youthful, glamorous, beauty filter, airbrushed
